fields.headline: Evaluation after a possible sharps exposure
fields.agentClass: a Risk Group 2 bacterium, BSL-2 work
responseSteps: Site washed at the laboratory sink before evaluation.
Worker evaluated within one hour of the exposure.
recommendations: Worker may return to non-laboratory duties.
Biosafety officer to confirm the classification before work resumes in Room 214.
reporting: Occupational Health to the biosafety officer today.
Employee injury report to Human Resources within the institution deadline.
